body:
Claim: benchmark suite live run (session S465, agent Zuri).

Scope: scripts/lm_benchmark.py only.

Intended changes:
- Per-adapter model pin + --adapter/--model flags (same shape as the
  dir_explorer harness pin in aa08cd5; bankofai default pinned to
  qwen3.8-flash because its configured deepseek-v4-flash is delisted).
- Token-efficiency metrics: capture provider input/output/total tokens per
  test and an aggregate quality-per-token summary in the results JSON.
- New tests closing benchmark-design gaps: memory conflict/temporal
  (multi-turn), coding-fixture bug fix + minimal-change checks, and a real
  tool-failure recovery test; minimal multi-turn support for the same
  session_id.

Why safe: single file, no backend/product code touched; Elena's released
dir_explorer scope (scripts/live_test_dir_explorer.py, tool_schemas.py,
tests) is untouched; the suite is scratch-evidence tooling, not runtime.

Verification: --list offline; one smoke test live before the batch.
